Hi Piper — thanks for sending over the packet and W-9, I took a quick pass and we need a couple of insurance confirmations before Procurement can issue a PO. High-level requirements:

- Commercial General Liability: $2,000,000 per occurrence / $4,000,000 aggregate (or carrier-equivalent)
- Products/Completed Ops: included at the same limits
- Business Auto Liability: $1,000,000 combined single limit (any auto)
- Umbrella/Excess: $5,000,000
- Professional / Technology E&O (if applicable to the work): $2,000,000

Operational items we need on the certificate/endorsement:
- Redwood Inference, Inc. to be named as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent) with primary and non-contributory wording
- Waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Policy endorsement or statement that coverage is primary and non-contributory
- Certificate holder address: Redwood Inference, Inc., 1201 Market St., San Francisco, CA 94103

If you can get a COI that shows the above or an endorsement from your carrier that amends the policy in writing, Procurement can proceed to issue a conditional PO. Please ensure the endorsement references our legal name exactly and includes policy numbers and effective dates.

Two additional asks: please confirm Parallax's legal entity name and EIN as shown on the W-9, and if you carry Cyber/Privacy liability, send that COI as well — it’s optional but helpful for our risk review.

I’m copying Marcus (Procurement) and Grace (Vendor Risk) to speed review. If you anticipate carrier turnaround time, let us know so we can mark the timeline in the procurement ticket.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Strategic Partnerships (covering vendor intake)
Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com

Attachment note: We only accepted PDF attachments; if the endorsement comes as a separate PDF from the carrier that’s ideal.

Thanks Piper — quick procurement note from my side:

1) Please request an Additional Insured endorsement with primary/non-contributory language and a Waiver of Subrogation. If your carrier needs sample wording, ask them to include: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its directors, officers and employees are named as Additional Insureds with primary and non-contributory status."
2) Please provide policy effective/expiration dates and the carriers for each line.
3) Upload the endorsement and the final COI to our vendor onboarding form so we can close PRC-3421. Link: https://redwoodinc.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/vendor-onboarding-form-PRC-3421

Note: Procurement will issue a conditional PO number (COND-1789) to start onboarding once the endorsement is delivered and the vendor agreement is countersigned; final invoicing will require the full, endorsed COI.

Grace — can you confirm if Cyber liability would change the PO terms or required clauses for this engagement?
